attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long spine.** Columns 0 to 39, `kduI` to `fucI`, are carried by 93 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and 0 to 23% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names 14 to 99.8% of genes, mean 95%; its fewest named call is at column 10, `ygdR`, named 14%, and its most hesitant column is 28, `mltA`, 0.71 bits.

**A single variable column follows.** Column 40, `fucP`, is in a region of plasticity in 18% of calls, named 94%, 0.58 bits. Then columns 41 to 52, `fucA` to `gudP`, are spine again: 91 to 95% carried, all persistent, 10 to 19% in a region of plasticity, named 89 to 99%, mean 96%.

**The window then opens into fork and variable columns.** Columns 53 to 79 are in a region of plasticity in 3 to 80% of calls, named 47 to 98%, mean 91%; the fewest named is column 53, 47%, and the most hesitant is column 63, `ygcG`, 1.24 bits. A second branch of 3 families runs through columns 63 to 65, a parallel path some chromosomes carry instead, in 11 to 15% of chromosomes, all shell: a TPM domain-containing protein, a hypothetical protein and a LemA family protein.

**The variable columns carry many families.** Columns 53 to 62, `gudX` to `eno`, in 78 to 88% of chromosomes, include `mazE` and `mazF`, [[toxin-antitoxin system]]. Columns 67 to 78, `yqcE` to `cysI`, in 67 to 77% of chromosomes, include `cysJ` and `cysI`, [[assimilatory sulfite reduction]]. The window ends at column 79, `cysH`, in 57% of chromosomes.

**The model names genes readily in the spine and hesitates in the open stretches.** Across the window it names 94% of genes, 0.25 bits on average. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.77 against 0.13 bits, and names fewer genes, 86% against 96%.

label: kduI
facts:
WINDOW: the kduI window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor kduI, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 889 to 968 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying kduI once); 42,880 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.25 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,039 calls, named 96%, 0.12 bits; shell 8,508 calls, named 88%, 0.67 bits; cloud 333 calls, named 34%, 2.79 bits. Outside an RGP 34,959 calls, named 96%, 0.13 bits; inside an RGP 7,921 calls, named 86%, 0.77 bits. Columns: 52 spine, 5 fork, 23 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.77 against 0.13 bits) and names fewer genes (86% against 96%); 7,921 of the 42,880 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 63 (ygcG) 1.24 bits, RGP 63%; column 66 (ygcE) 0.84 bits, RGP 71%; column 28 (mltA) 0.71 bits, RGP 21%. The 11 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 91%, 0.54 bits on average; the other 69 columns: named 94%, 0.20 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 53-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 3-80%; the least: columns 0-39 (spine), RGP 0-23%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-39 (40 columns) spine: share 93-100%, all P, RGP 0-23%. Genes: kduI "5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucuronate iso…", kduD, araE, ygeA "aspartate/glutamate racemase", lysR, lysA "diaminopimelate decarboxylase", galR, aas, lplT, tas, ygdR "YgdI/YgdR family lipoprotein", ygdQ "TerC family protein", mutH, ygdT "protein YgdT", rppH, ptsP, lgt, thyA, ppdA "prepilin peptidase-dependent protein", ppdB, ygdB "DUF2509 family protein", ppdC, recC, ptrA, recB, recD "ATP-binding domain-containing prote…", argA, amiC, mltA, tcdA, csdE, csdA "cysteine desulfurase CsdA", ygdI "YgdI/YgdR family lipoprotein", gcvA, ygdD "DUF423 domain-containing protein", rlmM, fucR "L-fucose operon activator", fucU, fucK, fucI. named 14-99.8% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 10 (ygdR), named 14%; most hesitant at column 28 (mltA), 0.71 bits.
2. column 40 variable: RGP 18%. named 94%; 0.58 bits.
   40: fucP S 85%
3. columns 41-52 (12 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 10-19%. Genes: fucA, fucO, xni, sdaB, sdaC "HAAAP family serine/threonine perme…", ppnN, queF, syd, yqcC "YqcC family protein", truC, yqcA "flavodoxin", gudP. named 89-99% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 52 (gudP), named 89%; most hesitant at column 44 (sdaB), 0.34 bits.
4. columns 53-79 (27 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 3-80%. named 47-98% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 53, named 47%; most hesitant at column 63, 1.24 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 63-65, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-15%, all S; the branch's families: "TPM domain-containing protein", "hypothetical protein", "LemA family protein"
   columns 53-62 variable, share 78-88%, 8 P, 2 S: gudX 87%, gudD "enolase C-terminal domain-like prot…" 88%, barA 87%, rlmD 86%, relA 86%, mazE 78%, mazF 78%, mazG "nucleoside triphosphate pyrophospho…" 85%, pyrG 85%, eno 85%
   63 fork: ygcG S 65% "TPM domain-containing protein"
   64 fork: yqcG S 48%
   65 fork: queE P 85%
   66 fork: ygcE S 77% "FGGY family carbohydrate kinase"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 18%
   columns 67-78 variable, share 67-77%, 7 S, 5 P: yqcE "MFS transporter" 77%, ygcW "SDR family oxidoreductase" 76%, ygcU "FAD-binding oxidoreductase" 76%, ygcS "MFS transporter" 76%, ygcR "electron transfer flavoprotein subu…" 76%, ygcQ "electron transfer flavoprotein subu…" 74%, ygcP "glycerol-3-phosphate responsive ant…" 75%, ygcO "ferredoxin family protein" 77%, ygcN "FAD-dependent oxidoreductase" 72%, queD 72%, cysJ 70%, cysI "NADPH-dependent assimilatory sulfit…" 67%
   79 fork: cysH P 57%; also small P 18%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): kduD SDR family NAD(P)-dependent oxidoreduct…; ppdB prepilin peptidase-dependent protein; recB UvrD-helicase domain-containing protein; fucU L-fucose mutarotase; fucK L-fuculokinase; fucP L-fucose:H+ symporter permease; fucA L-fuculose-phosphate aldolase; fucO iron-containing alcohol dehydrogenase; sdaB L-serine ammonia-lyase, iron-sulfur-dep…; gudP MFS transporter; mazE type II toxin-antitoxin system antitoxi…; mazF endoribonuclease MazF; cysJ flavodoxin domain-containing protein; cysH phosphoadenosine phosphosulfate reducta…; small type I toxin-antitoxin system toxin HokE
END: the window ends at column 79, cysH, in 57% of chromosomes.
